row: Trooper Canine Rehabilitation is focused on the use of integrative veterinary medicine to provide improved pain management and rehabilitation to dogs and cats. We utilize manual therapy, advanced modalities, and targeted exercises to help pets regain mobility and to improve their quality of life.
